title: Volunteers wanted: sport management experience (2022)
excerpt: Zilina Bears looked for volunteers with sport management or rugby experience living in Zilina.
html:
Archívny článok – aktuálne tréningy a kontakty nájdeš na úvodnej stránke.

When: May 2022
Language: English

Dear public
The Zilina Bears Rugby club is looking for volunteers with sport management exp
Indeed, the club is growing and would like to get benefits from foreign experience.
Ideally if you are raised from rugby and grow into rugby community, and now living in Zilina, please contact.
As volunteer and potential future coach involved into our Zilina squad, you could get some nice benefits and gifts (but to be discussed in private message).
In case you have other exp (as football soccer, basketball, or any other) but interested about a rugby exp with an european fixtures (we have played against Cyprus, British teams, Spain Madrid, France and many others0, please contact us.
We have indeed a nice social group and you could be part to a strong rugby family.
